text.aria-label: Title text 'Probabilities above 0.5 are too high'

Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast origins, July 2025 to June 2026, injected transfers that start in even months. Pre-registered rows, shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6. One point per tenth of predicted probability that holds at least 200 rows. Dashed line: perfectly calibrated. 97% of rows fall in the lowest bin.'
text.tspan: 16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast origins, July 2025 to June 2026, injected
transfers that start in even months. Pre-registered rows, shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6. One
point per tenth of predicted probability that holds at least 200 rows. Dashed line:
perfectly calibrated. 97% of rows fall in the lowest bin.
